description: Describes a setting a webhook integration supports: what it does, the value it takes when a connector does not set it, and which values it accepts.

defaultValue.description: The value of the setting when a connector does not set it. Values are strings the integration's scripts parse; booleans are `true` or `false`. An empty string is a valid default. When validation is set, the default must match it, so a validation can also rule out an empty default.
defaultValue.title: defaultValue

description.description: A longer explanation of the setting, for when the short description is not enough, for example with the values it accepts and what each of them does.
description.title: description

name.description: The name of the setting. It must be the key the setting is listed under, start with an alphanumeric character and contain no spaces.
name.title: name

shortDescription.description: What the setting does, in one sentence.
shortDescription.title: shortDescription

validation.description: If set, a regular expression the value a connector sets must match, so a client can check a value before it is saved.
validation.title: validation

title: WebhookIntegrationSetting
